F0.derivativeConvention: ordinary physical X and ordinary eta, total order<=2

U0.derivativeConvention: ordinary physical X and ordinary eta, each order<=2

arithmetic.etaEndpointConvention: Continuous one-sided derivatives, justified by the same positive Gamma integrals.

actualExterior.definition: After the terminal stage fo=1 and the heat cutoff=1. No B8, C12, I1 or I2 bump remains. The actual field is amplitude*X^b*H(2*(1-eta^2)/X).
actualExterior.heightMeaning: The bound 2*C^2 applies to Aext*X^(-1-h), not to Aext alone.
actualExterior.heightProof: Aext*X^(-1-h)=Etail/(sqrt(2X)*(1-rho))*(X/Xtail)^(-A). Etail<=Pstar<C, X>=Xb>=Xtail>1 and rho<1/2 imply the stated bound.

receipt.coverage: Xa/2<Xa<Xplus<Xb<2Xb; first two regions overlap. At every original join the exact smooth source jets agree.
receipt.physicalConversion: dX=X^-1*Dy; dX^2=X^-2*(Dy^2-Dy), no term omitted. The first region already supplies ordinary physical derivatives.

independentReview.reviewScope: Actual power-prefactor height, Gamma moments and total2 chain, physical X conversion, closed-domain coverage, one-sided eta endpoints. Independent fresh source execution checked all eight source checks.
